title: Elina Pilates Cadillac Reformer
overviewParagraph: The Cadillac Reformer is a premium Pilates machine built from American rock maple for a stable, long-lasting platform for full-body training. Stainless steel and anodized aluminum components boost durability and smooth operation, while the innovative loop handle system slides silently to keep sessions focused and comfortable. A leather-upholstered bed with high-density EVA foam cushions your body for better support during Pilates work. It also complies with environmental regulations, making it a responsible choice for home or studio use.
